frontmatter.name: graphify
frontmatter.description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

nodes.label: Linux verification (dotnet test + tools/check-build/check.sh with genstubs.py)
nodes.norm_label: linux verification (dotnet test + tools/check-build/check.sh with genstubs.py)
nodes.rationale: XAML compiler does not run on Linux, so genstubs.py generates x:Name/InitializeComponent stubs and checks event handlers and x:Bind paths; only a real Windows build validates XAML markup.

nodes.label: Device properties changed only on UI thread via DispatcherQueue
nodes.norm_label: device properties changed only on ui thread via dispatcherqueue
nodes.rationale: MQTT callbacks and timers run on background threads while Device is INotifyPropertyChanged bound to UI.

nodes.label: Unpackaged exe build (WindowsPackageType=None, self-contained Windows App SDK)
nodes.norm_label: unpackaged exe build (windowspackagetype=none, self-contained windows app sdk)
nodes.rationale: No certificate, developer mode or installed Windows App Runtime needed; system had only framework 1.5 without DDLM/Main so framework-dependent exe did not start. Consequence: ApplicationData/Windows.Storage unused, only Data/LocalStore.
